verdict.rationale: Clerk's own eve tool-call authorization guide says it can "broker OAuth for tools that need a provider token on the caller's behalf." That is a first-party claim of delegated third-party token brokering for agent tool calls. However, the evidence is a single summary line with no detail on how the flow actually works. missing for 10: documentation that brokered tokens are short-lived, the user-consent flow, token storage/refresh (vault) mechanics, supported third-party providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
